learning_objective: 🎯 Become a master designer by learning how to mix shapes, colors, and repeating motifs to create beautiful patterns!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A design is a thoughtful arrangement of lines, shapes, and colors. Good design is everywhere, from the beautiful borders on a saree to the cool graphics on your favorite t-shirt!
A motif is a single basic shape or drawing, like a tiny flower or a geometric star. When you take this one motif and repeat it over and over, you magically create a pattern!

Symmetry means both sides of a design match perfectly. If you draw a line down the middle of a butterfly, the left wing looks exactly like the right wing. Symmetry makes designs look calm and balanced.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Nature's Mandala
fun_activity.instructions: Go outside and collect some small leaves, pebbles, and twigs. Arrange them on the ground in a circular design starting from the center and working your way out, keeping both sides symmetrical!

quick_recap: ⭐ Design is the art of arranging lines, shapes, and colors in a pleasing way.
⭐ A motif is a basic unit or shape that is used to build a bigger design.
⭐ Repeating a motif in an organized way creates a beautiful continuous pattern.
⭐ Symmetrical designs look balanced because both sides mirror each other.
